notes:
What's new:
- "Open folder" after every job - opens the folder with your new file already selected.
- The app remembers where you save. Choose a folder once and every tool uses it.
- Reorder files before merging - drag them, or use the arrows, remove one, or Sort by name.
- "Fonts in this PDF" in Edit Text - see which fonts are missing and install them for an exact match.
- Each tool now says what it is doing (Compressing..., Merging...) instead of looking idle.
What's fixed:
- Edit Text no longer garbles replacement text when you edit the same line twice.
- Edit Text puts the cursor in the box, so you can just type.
- Fonts are matched against everything installed on your PC - sans-serif text is no longer replaced with a serif font.
- Rotate Pages now loads a PDF (choosing a file used to do nothing).
- Compare, Split and PDF to Images now offer "Open folder" too.
